{{Intro/Quest|To Mt. Firmament}}

==Summary==
In the pouring rain, you encounter Changli, the Wayfinder, at the ferry. She describes the peculiar nature of time at Mt. Firmament, where it flows erratically. She notes your resemblance to a historic visitor who was immune to this temporal distortion and offers to accompany you into this dangerous realm. 

You and Changli come to a damaged bridge that leads to Mt. Firmament. You find a Chronosorter in the vicinity, a Court of Savantae creation believed to have the power to restore objects by rewinding time. Perhaps it can be used to repair the bridge? 

Upon entering Mt. Firmament, you find that the flow of time has spiraled out of control, with many creatures falling victim to it. Leaving the mountain now could lead to unpredictable aging. Changli finds her Terminal is not working and suggests hurrying to Hongzhen, a town that Jinhsi must pass through in her search for the Sentinel. 

Hongzhen resembles a place from your dreams. Changli speculates that your dreams might be a glimpse into your past and a light guiding you into the future. Here, you meet the Fractsidus and discover traces of Jinhsi's Resonance Ability, and you decide to follow them. 

You and Changli enter a hidden chamber. Xinyi greets you. She is an old acquaintance of Changli's and once held a prominent position in City Hall before retiring to Hongzhen. She asks you to follow her.

You learn that the Sentinel may be trapped in its resting place—the Mianloong Chamber. The Fractsidus invasion has activated the defenses built by the Court of Savantae, sealing the chamber. Jinhsi left shortly before to go to Truthseeker's Pass to retrieve the Cipher Key needed to unseal it. You and Changli continue to trace her steps.

# Arrive at Mt. Firmament
# Repair the Bridge with Chronosorter

# Defeat the Fractsidus
# Go Further into Mt. Firmament
# Disable the Photonvault and Photon Barrier
# Head to the Temporal Barrier Through the Cave
# Cross the Temporal Barrier
# Go Further into Mt. Firmament
# Head to the Truthseeker's Pass

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_1.ogg}} '''??:''' Are you trapped here by the rain?
:{{DIcon}} No, I'm waiting for someone.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_4.ogg}} '''??:''' I happen to be waiting for someone, too.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_5.ogg}} '''??:''' No need for thanks. We're about to embark on a journey together, {{Rover}}.
:{{DIcon}} Who are you?
:{{DIcon}} Are you the "Wayfinder"?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_8.ogg}} '''??:''' I am [[Changli]], your "Wayfinder".
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_9.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Don't worry. The rain won't last much longer. Our destination lies just beyond it.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_10.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}}, what do you know about [[Mt. Firmament]]?
:{{DIcon}} Not much.
:{{DIcon}} It's the place where [[Jinzhou]] was founded?
:{{DIcon}} What on earth is going on in that place?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_14.ogg}} '''Changli:''' There is... a certain folk tale. Have you heard of it?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_15.ogg}} '''Changli:''' While hiking in the mountains, a woodcutter came upon two people playing Weiqi and became enthralled with their game.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_16.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Upon his return home, he found a world transformed. Everything was different, as if in a new reality.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_17.ogg}} '''Changli:''' That mountain was a secret realm where time worked differently. The woodcutter only spent half a day inside, but outside, a century had passed.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_18.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Mt. Firmament is such a place.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_19.ogg}} '''Changli:''' But unlike this folk tale, there is a price to pay for entering and exiting its grounds.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_20.ogg}} '''Changli:''' If I spend a full day in the mountains, ten days will be taken off my lifespan upon my leaving, reflecting the actual time that has passed outside.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_21.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Not to mention... the situation on Mt. Firmament right now is probably even more complex than before.
:{{DIcon}} What happened?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_23.ogg}} '''Changli:''' The strange time patterns of Mt. Firmament are tied to the [[Sentinel]]'s Temporal Mandate. Time ebbs and flows at its will.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_24.ogg}} '''Changli:''' If the [[Fractsidus]] really has imprisoned our [[Jué|Sentinel]], causing it to lose control of its powers, that could explain the Temporal Disruptions... which means Mt. Firmament is basically a dead end with no way out.
:{{DIcon}} And you are heading straight into that dead end.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_26.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Lifespan is not the top of my concerns. If you've decided to venture there... I'll join you as your Wayfinder.     
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_27.ogg}} '''Changli:''' [[Jinhsi]] has stayed on Mt. Firmament for too long.
:{{DIcon}} Sanhua said she might be in danger.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_29.ogg}} '''Changli:''' She doesn't miss a thing, does she?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_30.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Before Jinhsi left for Mt. Firmament, scales began appearing on her body, and her Resonance Ability was weakening. 
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_31.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Those signs pointed to a dire situation for the Sentinel as well.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_32.ogg}} '''Changli:''' That's why I must lead you there. You might have the key to solving our dilemma.
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_34.ogg}} '''Changli:''' You're here because I invited you. [[Sanhua]] was instructed to disclose my whereabouts if you ever went to [[City Hall]] and asked about Jinhsi.
:{{DIcon}} Why would you tell me?
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_37.ogg}} '''Changli:''' From what I understand, there is a strong link between you and the Sentinel. More importantly, you've been the primary target of the Fractsidus.
:{{DIcon}} How did you know I'd go to the City Hall?
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_38.ogg}} '''Changli:''' It's no surprise that you went to City Hall for answers, considering your memory loss and Jinhsi's prolonged absence.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_39.ogg}} '''Changli:''' I need to tell you the truth... Because you've been the top priority—No, the sole concern of our enemy. The Fractsidus.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_40.ogg}} '''Changli:''' That Overseer tried everything to sway you and make you join their side before our battle with the reviving [[Threnodian]].
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_41.ogg}} '''Changli:''' It's a clear sign that your involvement could disrupt their plans, especially at Mt. Firmament.
:{{DIcon}} Why do they care so much about me?
:{{DIcon}} It seems everyone's interested in me...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_44.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Records at the [[Grand Library]] tell a tale of someone who dared to enter Mt. Firmament after the Sentinel's descent. And they emerged unscathed, as if time had no hold on them.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_45.ogg}} '''Changli:''' They were also said to have "stood alongside the Sentinel".
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_46.ogg}} '''Changli:''' And here before me stands someone who bears an uncanny resemblance to that very individual.
:{{DIcon}} You think that person is me?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_48.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Is it you? If not you, who else could it be?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_49.ogg}} '''Changli:''' It took me some effort to finally reach this conclusion.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_50.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}}, the journey ahead is filled with danger at every turn. Once we venture into the mountains, there's no turning back. Are you sure you still want to join me?
:{{DIcon}} Yes. The strange time pattern can't hurt me.
:{{DIcon}} I am the key to solving your dilemma. Then why ask?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_53.ogg}} '''Changli:''' As your Wayfinder, I'll lead you to your destination. What you do after that is entirely up to you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_54.ogg}} '''Changli:''' The rain is subsiding, and the sky will soon clear.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_30_55.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}}, it's time for us to head out.
----
;(Cutscene Plays)
;(Cutscene Ends)

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_35_1.ogg}} '''Changli:''' We're at the base of Mt. Firmament, but we won't enter the Temporal Barrier until we cross the Luminous Shore.    
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_35_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Shall we proceed? The storm is coming... Some people must be itching to pounce.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_1.ogg}} '''Changli:''' The bridge has broken...
:{{DIcon}} What's this?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Judging by its design and intricate details, it must be a creation of the Court of Savantae.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_4.ogg}} '''Changli:''' This is what they call a Chronosorter...
:{{DIcon}} What is that?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_6.ogg}} '''Changli:''' It mimics the Sentinel's {{Rubi|Temporal Mandate|Ability to control time}}, able to reverse small-scale events and restore objects to their previous state.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_7.ogg}} '''Changli:''' My master once told me about the Court of Savantae and their fearless quest to unravel the mysteries of Mt. Firmament, risking all in their pursuit of understanding the strange flow of time.    
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_8.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Their dedication bore fruit in the form of fascinating inventions, such as this Chronosorter.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_9.ogg}} '''Changli:''' But it doesn't add up...
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_11.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Why hasn't this brilliant invention spread beyond Mt. Firmament?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_12.ogg}} '''Changli:''' This Chronosorter was built beyond the Temporal Barrier, so its creator must have already paid the price for leaving.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_13.ogg}} '''Changli:''' But even if they died, there are countless other {{Rubi|CSC members|[[Court of Savantae]] Committee}} who could replicate it. How did such advanced technology become lost?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_14.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Or... do these Chronosorters stop functioning once they are removed from Mt. Firmament?
:{{DIcon}} What should we do now?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_16.ogg}} '''Changli:''' This Chronosorter, weathered though it may appear, bears no signs of neglect. Someone has tended to it diligently.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_40_17.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Let's give it a try.

;(After crossing the bridge)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_45_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_45_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Weren't they concerned about losing lifespan?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_45_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' For those fanatics, nothing mattered more than the truth.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_45_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' To live every moment with overwhelming passion... How many can claim such a tenacious drive and unshakable determination?

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_55_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' They've set traps all around the Luminous Shore...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_55_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' They must have anticipated your arrival.

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_56_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_56_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' The entrance is sealed.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_56_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' It's the Photon Barrier. Another invention from the Court of Savantae.

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_57_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Use long-range weapons on the Photonvaults to cut off its energy.

;(After shooting both Photonvaults)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_58_1.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Once we reach the cave's end, we'll enter the domain of Mt. Firmament. Proceed with caution.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' So it can't hurt me...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Is this the effect of that strange time pattern you mentioned?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_4.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Time on Mt. Firmament used to simply flow slower than in the outside world. Visitors were safe as long as they remained within the Temporal Barrier.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_5.ogg}} '''Changli:''' But what we're seeing now is different. The flow of time has gone haywire. This is what we call the Temporal Disruptions...   
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_6.ogg}} '''Changli:''' What was once slow and steady has become chaotic and turbulent. Some areas are frozen in time, while others speed up or slow down unpredictably.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_7.ogg}} '''Changli:''' No one knows how much they'll age after leaving Mt. Firmament, but aging from youth to old age may be a blessing compared to the unknown fate that awaits.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_8.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Leaving Mt. Firmament could turn any mortal to dust in just a moment. Such is the power of time within its walls.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_9.ogg}} '''Changli:''' These poor creatures, trapped in the Temporal Disruption, are the most pitiful of all... Their bodies and minds have been ravaged by the chaotic time, leaving them in unimaginable suffering...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_10.ogg}} '''Changli:''' So, it looks like the Fractsidus did manage to capture our Sentinel, leading to the Temporal Disruptions we are facing now.  
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_11.ogg}} '''Changli:''' I had wished that my theories would turn out wrong...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_13.ogg}} '''Changli:''' ...As expected, my [[Terminal]] isn't working. We can't reach Jinhsi.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_14.ogg}} '''Changli:''' The Temporal Disruption is preventing it from functioning.
:{{DIcon}} Jinhsi...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_16.ogg}} '''Changli:''' We can't waste a moment. Jinhsi's fate isn't the only one at stake—all the inhabitants of Mt. Firmament are in danger.       
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_60_17.ogg}} '''Changli:''' We need to hurry to Hongzhen, a town nestled at the heart of Mt. Firmament. Jinhsi would likely pass through there on her search for the Sentinel.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' The Temporal Disruptions have spared nothing on our way here...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_2_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_2_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Changli, does that mean you're in danger too?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_4.ogg}} '''Changli:''' So far, nothing feels out of the ordinary. It seems the Sentinel contained the situation before being fully trapped.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_5.ogg}} '''Changli:''' But I don't know how long this stability will hold.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_6.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}}, if I go down... please don't worry about me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_65_7.ogg}} '''Changli:''' You need only focus on what you have to do.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_1.ogg}} '''Changli:''' What's the matter, {{Rover}}?
:{{DIcon}} I dreamed of this place...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' You dreamed of Hongzhen?
:'''You describe your dream from last night.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_5.ogg}} '''Changli:''' It sounds like you did dream of this place.
:{{DIcon}} I dreamed of [[Hongzhen]] being attacked by TDs.    
:{{DIcon}} I dreamed of the Sentinel protecting people here.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_8.ogg}} '''Changli:''' What you just described closely aligns with the accounts documented in our Grand Library.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_9.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Over a century ago, a vast horde of [[Tacet Discord]]s invaded [[Huanglong]]. Hongzhen suffered greatly during that onslaught.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_10.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Thankfully, the Sentinel descended, manipulating time to erect a protective barrier, keeping those monsters at bay.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_11.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}}, perhaps... That dream is more than just a dream.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_12.ogg}} '''Changli:''' It could be a glimpse into your own past, and... a guiding light for the future.
;(Rover and Changli hide from The Fractsidus)
:{{DIcon}} It's the Fractsidus.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_14.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Hongzhen is a pivotal location, linking various parts of Mt. Firmament. With the Fractsidus now targeting us, they'll seize any opportunity to intercept our path.
:{{DIcon}} They've laid a trap in Hongzhen.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_16.ogg}} '''Changli:''' But every trap has its weak points.
:{{DIcon}} What's this?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_18.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Someone has used their Resonance Ability here, but it feels different from the Fractsidus' aggression... It's Jinhsi.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_19.ogg}} '''Changli:''' And it seems like she used it in a dire situation. Could it be related to the people of Hongzhen?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_20.ogg}} '''Changli:''' The traces lead deeper into the heart of Hongzhen.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_70_21.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Let's keep moving, {{Rover}}. Don't let your guard down.

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_110_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_110_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' The traces end here.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_110_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Let's search the area. There should be more clues nearby.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_113_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_113_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Someone fought here against those Fractsidus...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_113_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Must be Jinhsi. Her trails led to this location.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_113_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Using her Resonance Ability too much would only worsen her condition...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_113_4.ogg}} '''Changli:''' But she must have had a reason... Was she helping the people of Hongzhen find refuge?
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_115_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_115_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Changli, there are traces here.       
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_115_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' They're pointing north... Let's proceed in that direction.

;(When player reaches the end of the traces)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_120_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_120_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' The traces disappear by the pond.     
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_120_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}}, we need to keep an eye out for anything unusual.

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_128_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_128_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' There's something behind the waterfall.

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_130_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_130_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Another Photon Barrier.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_130_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Three Photonvaults to break. {{Rover}}, use ranged attacks.
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_1.ogg}} '''Cautious Guard:''' You two! Halt!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_2.ogg}} '''??:''' Hold on.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_3.ogg}} '''Cautious Guard:''' Lady [[Xinyi]]...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_4.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Relax, they're our honored guests. No need to be tense.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_5.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' In a single day, we've greeted both the Magistrate of Jinzhou and her trusted Counselor in Hongzhen. I can only assume something significant happened.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_6.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' It's been a while, Changli.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_7.ogg}} '''Changli:''' I heard you stepped down from your position and moved to the countryside.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_8.ogg}} '''Changli:''' And now here we are, meeting again after all this time, in such unfortunate circumstances...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_9.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' For years I lived secluded, no longer concerning myself with the matters beyond Hongzhen.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_10.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' But the current situation in Jinzhou is volatile... It has reunited us in an unpredictable moment.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_11_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_11_F.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' And you, young {{MC|m=sir|f=lady}}... What shall I call you?
:{{DIcon}} {PlayerName}.
:{{DIcon}} Rover.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_140_14.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' My name is Xinyi. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
:'''Xinyi:''' Please follow me this way. It's not safe to talk here. 
----
;(When player chooses to talk to the Hongzhen resident)
:'''Bing'ge:''' ...Please pardon my rudeness earlier. I... I didn't know you  were here to help Madam Magistrate.
:{{DIcon}} I don't mind.
:{{DIcon}} You were just doing your job.
:'''Bing'ge:''' ...Thank you for your understanding.
:'''Bing'ge:''' First the Temporal Disruption, and now the Fractsidus. When will we ever get a break... If trouble finds us again, our people won't stand a chance.
:'''Bing'ge:''' Anyway, I still want to make it up to you.
:'''Bing'ge:''' Just give me a call if you need anything at Mt. Firmament.
<!--No idea whether there are more or not-->
----
;(When player chooses to talk to the Hongzhen resident)
:'''Uncle Fu:''' You there, young {{MC|m=man|f=lady}}. I bet you have more important things to do. Don't let an old man like me hold you back. Go and accomplish your tasks with purpose.
:{{DIcon}} What makes you think so?
:'''Uncle Fu:''' My eyes may be old and blurry, but my mind is sharp as ever.
:'''Uncle Fu:''' I've lived my whole life in Mt. Firmament, but people are all the same no matter where you go. Our actions reveal our true character.
:'''Uncle Fu:''' And now, at this crucial turning point for Mt. Firmament, your arrival... Yes... It is no mere coincidence.
:'''Uncle Fu:''' In these troubled times, you may hold the key to bring about much-needed change.

;(When player follows Xinyi)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_1.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' I believe you are here for Magistrate Jinhsi?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_2.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' The Magistrate left Hongzhen about fifteen minutes ago. She should be at the [[Truthseeker's Pass]] now.
:{{DIcon}} The Truthseeker's Pass?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_4.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' That's what they call it in Hongzhen. You might know it better as the ruins of a Court of Savantae facility.   
:{{DIcon}} What is Jinhsi doing there?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_6.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Lady Xinyi, please elaborate.
;(Flashback starts)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_7.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Madam Magistrate, are you...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_8.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I'm... fine...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_9.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' How's the situation? Have we evacuated all the civilians?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_10.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Yes. Remaining civilians have been counted and escorted to safety.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_11.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Good. These hidden chambers should provide some much-needed shelter for them to rest a little...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_12.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Despite being the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, I haven't been able to sense its presence for some time now...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_13.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I can feel my Resonance Ability waning, and I get my power from the Sentinel. This can only mean one thing: the Sentinel's condition is getting worse.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_14.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Lady Xinyi, I need to know where the Sentinel was last seen.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_15.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I can only fix the Temporal Disruption within a confined radius. It's already pushing my limits to keep this small pocket of space secure.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_16.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Mt. Firmament is in serious trouble, and we can't waste any more time. We need our Sentinel to stabilize the time flow.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_17.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' The Sentinel was last seen flying towards [[Mianloong Chamber]], where it would normally rest. The Fractsidus likely swarmed it soon after.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_18.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' But little did they know, we had a defense system in place, built with the help of the Court of Savantae. It was reactivated as soon as our Sentinel made it back inside.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_19.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' This mechanism has allowed us to locate their troops, and we've already eliminated some of them outside the Mianloong Chamber.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_20.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' To get inside Mianloong Chamber, we have to find the Cipher Key in Truthseeker's Pass and unseal it with the Keyforge.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_21.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Understood. I will go bring back the Cipher Key.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_22.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' You are injured... Please rest and leave it to me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_24.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' The Fractsidus will most likely attack this place once I leave. You must stay here and guard it.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_25.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I implore you, Xinyi. Help me keep our people safe.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_26.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' ...Yes, I will, Madam Magistrate.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_27.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...Before I headed to Mt. Firmament, the Fractsidus revealed a prophecy from our Sentinel: a fateful clash between the Sentinel and myself that would shape the fate of our city.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_28.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I never intended to believe their baseless claims, but I was not surprised to hear it.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_29.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' The Sentinel had told me long ago that there would come a day when I surpass it in power. A day when the humans of Jinzhou take control of their own destiny.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_30.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...Once we save the Sentinel from danger, I intend to have a serious conversation with it about this prophecy.
;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_31.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' ...And then she left.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_32.ogg}} '''Changli:''' There's still one thing that doesn't add up—How did the Fractsidus kidnap our Sentinel?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_33.ogg}} '''Changli:''' The Mianloong Chamber was once renovated by the Court of Savantae. Do you think their research could be involved somehow?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_34.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' I'll look into what you said, but once we have the Cipher Key, the Mianloong Chamber will be left vulnerable to the Fractsidus' potential retaliation.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_35.ogg}} '''Changli:''' We must keep them at bay...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_36.ogg}} '''Changli:''' {{Rover}} and I are headed to the Truthseeker's Pass to meet up with Jinhsi. We'll distract the Fractsidus main forces, giving you an opportunity to stage your ambush.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_37.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' And the locals will handle the rest.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_38.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' I will send some men to open up the side exit for you. Head south and keep walking a couple of minutes, and you will see the Truthseeker's Pass downstream.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_39.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Thank you, Lady Xinyi. Please leave it to us.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_145_40.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' ...In this place she was born, and in this place she returns. Our Magistrate's fate is bound to Mt. Firmament...
----
;(When player goes outside)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_163_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_163_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Did Xinyi and Jinhsi know each other?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_163_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Jinhsi was chosen as a baby for her Resonance Ability, and raised in City Hall to become the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_163_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' All the government workers there helped care for and teach her at some point, including Lady Xinyi.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_163_4.ogg}} '''Changli:''' She grew up with immense responsibilities, forced to suppress her true nature from a young age. Thinking back, Jinhsi was only a teenage girl when she became the Magistrate...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_163_5.ogg}} '''Changli:''' She has been burdened with unimaginable weight that most cannot fathom.
----
;(When player arrives at Truthseeker's Pass)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_1_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' I assume this is the Truthseeker's Pass Xinyi mentioned.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_2.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Yes.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_3.ogg}} '''Changli:''' This should be another Chronosorter. It should work in similar ways with the one we saw near the Luminous Shore.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_4.ogg}} '''Changli:''' The entrance is built on that cliff, and it's been blocked...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_5.ogg}} '''Changli:''' We will need to break the three Photonvaults with ranged attacks first.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_6.ogg}} '''Changli:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} What is it, Changli?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_8.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Nothing. I was wondering, how did the Court of Savantae create such an advanced mechanism using the Sentinel's power? Mortals aren't supposed to be able to comprehend it.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_9.ogg}} '''Changli:''' I've never heard of any human civilization having the ability to manipulate time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_10.ogg}} '''Changli:''' Unless the Sentinel willingly taught them... But why?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_165_11.ogg}} '''Changli:''' We need to focus on items related to the Court of Savantae in Truthseeker's Pass. Maybe we can find some clues there.
{{Dialogue End}}
